subject: Future Tech
title: Narrow AI vs. General AI
description: A micro-lesson that makes Narrow AI vs. General AI usable.

hook.text: AlphaGo crushed the world Go champion. Then someone asked it to play tic-tac-toe. It couldn't.

buildup.text: Narrow AI excels at single tasks: face recognition, translation, chess.

discovery.text: Humans transfer skills effortlessly. A chef can learn to paint; a pilot can learn to cook.

twist.text: Large language models seem general—they write code, poems, and essays.

climax.text: The gap between narrow and general AI may be smaller than skeptics think or larger than optimists hope.

punchline.text: Brilliant at one thing. Clueless at the next. That's narrow AI.

quiz.question: What ability does AGI need that narrow AI lacks?
